name: YOUR_NAME
gpu_used: none - CPU only (4 vCPU cloud container); all latencies are CPU numbers

task1.bm25_settings: Okapi BM25 (own scipy implementation, Lucene IDF), k1=1.2, b=0.3, title+abstract, lowercase, sklearn English stopwords removed, Snowball stemming; grid over k1 x b x stemming x stopwords x tokenizer x title on val

task3.hybrid_method: minmax-normalised score interpolation (per-claim top-100), weights BM25 over abstracts expanded with training claims=1.0, bge-base=0.5, MedCPT=0.25
task3.reranker_model: ncbi/MedCPT-Cross-Encoder fine-tuned 2 epochs on training claims (BCE, BM25 hard negatives) (doc text = citing training claims | title + abstract)

task5.retriever_used: t3_hybrid top-3; evidence selected by cross-encoder score (mean of z-scored MedCPT-Cross-Encoder and our fine-tuned copy (the t3_rerank model))
task5.nli_model: MoritzLaurer/DeBERTa-v3-base-mnli-fever-anli: mean of zero-shot and fine-tuned (2 epochs on training-claim rationales) probabilities; label only, the cross-encoder decides which abstracts are evidence
